title: Networking Essentials
description: Requests, responses, protocols, DNS, and HTTP status codes.

questions.prompt: Which protocol normally carries encrypted web traffic?
questions.explanation: HTTPS protects HTTP traffic using TLS.

questions.prompt: What system translates domain names into IP addresses?
questions.explanation: The Domain Name System resolves names to addresses.

questions.prompt: A server can respond after receiving and processing a client request.
questions.explanation: The request-response exchange is foundational to the web.

questions.prompt: Which HTTP status code means Not Found?
questions.explanation: 404 means the requested resource was not found.
